family: One fixed total scale-header language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. At large actual length N, the first L=ceil(log2 N) bits encode S-1; every scale1<=S<=2^L is evaluated by the same algorithm, rejected large plans return zero, and the finite small cutoff uses the fixed legacy evaluator. Exact parameters are k=P2(S^13 L^22 z^8),h=e=P2(S L^3),ell=P2(S^3 L^6 z^3),eprime=P2(S^5 L^9 z^3),d=P2(S^9 L^15 z^8),Y=P2(S^11 L^19 z^8),z=ceil(log2 L). Independence order h is separate from the BINARY index alphabet a=2; b=d0 and look-ahead steps are at most2. Initial dimension10000 and design dimension100 are fixed; five internal dimensions equal z. All header and field/matrix data are actual input bits, and condenser fields are computed deterministically. No good scale, advice, witness or field is supplied externally. The supplied proof gives one fixed-scale hard restriction at every sufficiently large actual integer length.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, on every input header and field string. There exist absolute constants B>0,N0 such that for every integer actual length N>=N0, unconditionally in the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^22*(log2(log2 N))^8. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^22*(log2(log2 N))^(8+epsilon), and hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(22+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. The proof fixes one actual header S0, not per-length advice: exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data, with P=L+O(S0^5 L^9 z^5)=o(k). Existence of S0 proves hardness only; the fixed evaluator computes every header. The supplied finite gate bound is4n-8d including all sharing and B2 tables.
